title.narrative: Partnership workshop Kenya - Inclusive Refugee Response

description.narrative: The Round Table brought together Government of Kenya at national level as well as Turkana County level; the UNHCR, international donors, the World Bank and IFC, Danish philanthropic foundations, and Kenya civil society organisations to debate refugee operations in Kenya. A high-level panel debated the New Refugees Act, and Government of Kenya’s position of moving away from encampment to the integrated settlement approach. The Round Table participants also debated the policy implication of the inclusive refugee response and the role of development partners. This was followed by a discussion of local leadership and private sector engagement; and the role of Civil Society Organisation in refugee operation and the implementation of a nexus approach - and in this regard the preparedness of the humanitarian organisations.

The purpose of the seminar is to bring together stakeholders from Kenya (Government of Kenya, UN organisations, donors and other relevant actors) and Denmark (UM, private foundations) to discuss perspectives of the new Danish support to inclusive refugee responses.
